top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of articles or adjectives that do not match the gender of the noun, leading to grammatical errors and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: El clorofila dentro de los cloroplastos...
examples.correct: La clorofila dentro de los cloroplastos...
examples.context: Misuse of masculine article with feminine noun.

examples.correct: los sentimientos
examples.context: Misuse of feminine article with masculine plural noun.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect or non-standard terms for well-known concepts or references, leading to confusion and misrepresentation of information.

examples.correct: Sueño de libertad
examples.context: Incorrect reference to Martin Luther King Jr.'s famous speech.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as '🌟' are used in introductions and instructions, which is considered informal and distracting in Spanish educational materials, especially for older students or professional contexts.

examples.wrong: ¡Bienvenidos a una emocionante aventura en el mundo de la programación! 🌟
examples.correct: ¡Bienvenidos a una emocionante aventura en el mundo de la programación!
examples.context: Lesson introductions

examples.wrong: Prepárate para aprender habilidades esenciales que te serán útiles en todos los aspectos de tu vida. 🌟
examples.correct: Prepárate para aprender habilidades esenciales que te serán útiles en todos los aspectos de tu vida.
examples.context: Instructional statements
Standalone decorative element

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of verb tense, often mixing present and past within the same sentence, leading to confusion and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Proporcionando recursos esenciales como agua y nutrientes, permitió la agricultura, que sustenta el crecimiento de una civilización.
examples.correct: Proporcionando recursos esenciales como agua y nutrientes, permitió la agricultura, que sustentó el crecimiento de una civilización.
examples.context: Quiz explanations describing historical processes.

examples.wrong: La idea de que las variables no puedan almacenar información es incorrecta y va en contra de los principios básicos de programación.
examples.correct: La idea de que las variables no pueden almacenar información es incorrecta y va en contra de los principios básicos de programación.
examples.context: General statements about programming concepts.

top_error_patterns.description: Misuse of definite articles with nouns, especially gender mismatches and omission of required articles, affecting grammatical accuracy and naturalness.

examples.wrong: para la camuflaje en su ambiente helado y para mantener calor.
examples.correct: para el camuflaje en su ambiente helado y para mantener el calor.
examples.context: Descriptions of animal adaptations.

examples.correct: perros de la pradera
examples.context: Naming animal species in educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of incorrect or misleading terms, especially anglicisms or literal translations, which can confuse learners and reduce localization quality.

examples.wrong: El legado de la ingeniosidad egipcia en la ingeniería es evidente en monumentos como las pirámides y el Sphinx.
examples.correct: El legado de la ingeniosidad egipcia en la ingeniería es evidente en monumentos como las pirámides y la Esfinge.
examples.context: References to historical monuments.

examples.wrong: En el lenguaje de programación, los enteros son capaces de almacenar números sin signo, lo que incluye valores positivos y negativos.
examples.correct: En el lenguaje de programación, los enteros son capaces de almacenar números con o sin signo, lo que incluye valores positivos y negativos.
examples.context: Explanations of programming concepts.

top_error_patterns.description: Exaggeration or overstatement of facts, leading to misleading information and reduced precision in educational content.

examples.wrong: Las zonas climáticas continentales tienen temperaturas extremadamente altas durante el verano.
examples.correct: Las zonas climáticas continentales pueden tener temperaturas altas durante el verano, pero no necesariamente extremas.
examples.context: Descriptions of climate zones.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or uncommon Spanish terms for well-known legal acts, which can cause confusion and reduce clarity for learners.

examples.correct: Ley de Derecho al Voto de 1965
examples.context: Referring to the Voting Rights Act of 1965 in educational or historical contexts.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Imperative Form in Pseudocode Instructions
top_error_patterns.description: Use of infinitive verb forms instead of the imperative in Spanish pseudocode, making instructions less natural and potentially confusing for learners.

examples.correct: IMPRIME número
examples.context: Imperative instructions in educational programming examples.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of unnatural or awkward sentence structures that hinder comprehension and reduce the professional tone of educational explanations.

examples.wrong: sería extremadamente limitado la capacidad de un programa
examples.correct: la capacidad de un programa... sería extremadamente limitada
examples.context: Explanatory sentences in educational content.

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations from English, such as 'para consistencia', are not idiomatic in Spanish and reduce the naturalness and professionalism of the content.

examples.correct: Usar letras minúsculas para mantener la consistencia.
examples.context: Instructions for formatting

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms like 'Outback australiano' is an anglicism that may not be widely understood by Spanish-speaking audiences. More neutral, localized terms improve accessibility.

examples.correct: el interior de Australia
examples.context: Geographical references

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission of Definite Articles with Abstract Nouns
top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles are omitted before abstract nouns or noun phrases, which is required in Spanish for specificity and naturalness.

examples.wrong: organización de trabajo y planificación logística
examples.correct: la organización del trabajo y la planificación logística
examples.context: Describing skills or knowledge areas in educational content

examples.wrong: la realidad completa o las opciones disponibles
examples.correct: completamente la realidad o las opciones disponibles
examples.context: Explaining psychological concepts or decision-making

top_error_patterns.description: Backticks are used to enclose variable names or assignments, which is not standard in Spanish educational texts unless referencing actual code syntax.

examples.correct: monedasJugador = 0
examples.context: Presenting code or variable assignments in quiz instructions

top_error_patterns.description: Use of regionalisms (e.g., 'puntajes') instead of standard terms (e.g., 'puntuaciones'), which may affect comprehension and consistency for broader audiences.

examples.correct: Monitorear puntuaciones en juegos.
examples.context: Describing game score tracking in educational content

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less common or non-standard terms (e.g., 'pensamiento grupal') instead of widely accepted terminology (e.g., 'pensamiento de grupo'), which may reduce clarity.

examples.correct: Pensamiento de grupo
examples.context: Referring to 'groupthink' in psychology or critical thinking contexts

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inconsistent Use of Plural vs. Singular Address
top_error_patterns.description: Switching between plural ('Prepárense') and singular ('Prepárate') forms of address can confuse learners and disrupt the tone consistency, especially when the material is intended for individual study.

examples.wrong: ¡Prepárense para explorar las zonas climáticas de la Tierra y aprender cómo afectan la vida en nuestro planeta! 🌍
examples.correct: ¡Prepárate para explorar las zonas climáticas de la Tierra y aprender cómo afectan la vida en nuestro planeta! 🌍
examples.context: Lesson instructions

top_error_patterns.description: Capitalizing terms like 'Verdadero' and 'Falso' in technical contexts is inconsistent with Spanish orthographic conventions, where these should be lowercase unless starting a sentence.

examples.correct: Booleano: verdadero o falso.
examples.context: Programming terminology explanations

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or terms that do not exist in Russian or are inappropriate for the context, leading to confusion and loss of meaning.

examples.correct: водоснабжение
examples.context: Technical term for 'water supply' rendered as a non-existent word.

examples.correct: норы
examples.context: Incorrect term for animal burrows.

examples.correct: океанические течения
examples.context: Nonexistent term for ocean currents.

top_error_patterns.description: Mistakes in gender, number, and case agreement, as well as incorrect verb forms, which obscure meaning and reduce clarity.

examples.correct: Каждая органелла в клетке
examples.context: Gender and number agreement in scientific description.

examples.correct: Принятие закона о гражданских правах
examples.context: Incorrect case in legal terminology.

examples.correct: могут храниться в переменной
examples.context: Incorrect verb form in programming context.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misspellings and mixing of Latin and Cyrillic scripts, which disrupts readability and professionalism.

examples.correct: разработаны
examples.context: Misspelled participle in scientific context.

examples.correct: органеллы
examples.context: Mixing Latin and Cyrillic in a biological term.

examples.correct: обрабатывать
examples.context: Insertion of English letters in a Russian verb.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of inaccurate or misleading scientific terms, which can misinform learners and undermine educational value.

examples.wrong: алгебраические выражения представляют собой математические уравнения
examples.correct: алгебраические выражения представляют собой математические выражения
examples.context: Confusion between 'expression' and 'equation' in math content.

examples.correct: цитоскелет
examples.context: Incorrect biological term for cytoskeleton.

examples.correct: кристы
examples.context: Incorrect term for mitochondrial structures.

top_error_patterns.description: Unnatural word order or sentence structure that impedes comprehension and reduces the quality of localization.

examples.wrong: подобно того, как каждый дележка в мастерской играет свою роль
examples.correct: подобно тому, как каждый мастер в мастерской играет свою роль
examples.context: Awkward analogy and incorrect syntax in educational explanation.

examples.correct: для большей силы и устойчивости
examples.context: Incorrect word order and agreement in scientific context.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that do not fit the historical or cultural context, leading to confusion or misrepresentation of facts.

examples.wrong: Средневековые торговцы использовали реку Нил как основной маршрут для обмена продукцией и товарами.
examples.correct: Древнеегипетские торговцы использовали реку Нил как основной маршрут для обмена продукцией и товарами.
examples.context: Refers to Ancient Egypt but uses 'medieval traders', which is historically inaccurate.

top_error_patterns.description: Recurring use of unnatural or imprecise lexical choices that reduce clarity and naturalness in Russian, often leading to awkward or unclear phrasing.

examples.correct: принимаются
examples.context: Describing decisions; 'делаются' is less idiomatic than 'принимаются' in Russian.

examples.correct: основу для структуры
examples.context: Describing a basis for structure; 'пластинку' is unclear and unnatural.

examples.correct: белые медведи
examples.context: Referring to animals in polar regions; 'медведи' is too general, 'белые медведи' is precise.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less precise or non-standard terms where a more accurate or commonly accepted Russian equivalent exists, affecting clarity and professional tone.

examples.correct: Амазонские дождевые леса
examples.context: Referring to the Amazon rainforest; standard term improves lexical precision.

examples.wrong: лето, когда температуры могут быть довольно высокими
examples.correct: лето, когда температура может быть довольно высокой
examples.context: General discussion of seasonal temperature; singular form is more natural.

examples.wrong: Океаническое течение, такое как Гольфстрим, делает климат Западной Европы мягче, чем в других местах на той же широте.
examples.correct: Океаническое течение, такое как Гольфстрим, делает климат Западной Европы более мягким, чем в других местах на той же широте.
examples.context: Comparative adjective use; 'более мягким' is more precise.

top_error_patterns.description: Mistakes in prepositional case agreement, such as using 'с' with the wrong case, which affects grammatical correctness and naturalness.

examples.correct: со средой обитания
examples.context: Preposition 'с' requires instrumental case and euphonic form 'со' before 'средой'.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inaccurate Lexical Choices for Cultural Context
top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that do not fit the historical or cultural context, leading to confusion or misrepresentation in educational content.

examples.correct: фермеров
examples.context: Referring to ancient Egyptian agricultural workers; 'товарищей' is an anachronistic and culturally inappropriate term.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of terminology or phrasing that is not standard in Russian educational materials, reducing clarity and pedagogical effectiveness.

examples.wrong: Это заключается в принципе обратности операций: если на одной стороне добавление, то на другой стороне вычитание.
examples.correct: Это отражает принцип равенства: любую операцию, выполненную с одной стороны уравнения, необходимо выполнить и с другой стороной.
examples.context: Explaining the balancing principle in math; 'принцип обратности операций' is not a recognized or clear term in Russian math education.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of generic or ambiguous referents where a more specific term would improve clarity and comprehension.

examples.wrong: Сложно выращивать культуры, но картофель может расти летом.
examples.correct: Сложно выращивать культуры, но некоторые, например картофель, могут расти летом.
examples.context: Implied exclusivity; specifying 'некоторые' clarifies potatoes are an example.

examples.wrong: Практика активного слушания позволяет слушателю полностью услышать точку зрения человека...
examples.correct: Практика активного слушания позволяет слушателю полностью услышать точку зрения другого человека...
examples.context: Clarifies whose perspective is being considered, improving referential accuracy.

top_error_patterns.description: Ensuring participle forms (e.g., 'нерешённые') are used consistently in similar contexts to maintain grammatical correctness and stylistic uniformity.

examples.wrong: Нерешённые конфликты могут вызывать стресс и негативные эмоции.
examples.correct: Нерешённые конфликты могут вызывать стресс и негативные эмоции.
examples.context: Participial form is correct; consistency should be maintained across items.

top_error_patterns.description: Examples provided are understandable but may not fully resonate with Russian audiences; substituting with more culturally relevant scenarios improves localization fit.

examples.wrong: например, спор о последнем кусочке пиццы
examples.correct: например, спор о последнем пирожке
examples.context: Examples in educational content

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less natural or formal terms instead of widely accepted Russian terminology, which can affect clarity and professional tone.

examples.correct: дизайном
examples.context: Project or educational context

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Overuse of loanwords in formal contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Preference for loanwords like 'креативный' over native Russian equivalents such as 'творческий', which may sound less natural in formal or educational settings.

examples.correct: более творческим рабочим условиям
examples.context: Describing work environments in educational materials

top_error_patterns.description: Instructions lack specificity or omit key qualifiers, leading to ambiguity or incomplete guidance, especially in procedural or safety contexts.

examples.wrong: Wash your hands to prevent infection.
examples.correct: Wash your hands thoroughly to prevent infection.
examples.context: Missing adverb reduces clarity about the required action.

examples.wrong: Clean the wound using clean water to remove dirt or debris.
examples.correct: Clean the wound with running clean water to remove dirt or debris.
examples.context: Omission of 'running' may result in improper first aid.

examples.wrong: Cool the burn under cool water for 10-15 minutes.
examples.correct: Cool the burn under running cool water for 10-15 minutes.
examples.context: Lack of 'running' could lead to less effective burn treatment.

examples.wrong: Perform the Heimlich maneuver if the person cannot cough out the object.
examples.correct: Perform abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver) if the person cannot cough out the object.
examples.context: Missing alternative terminology may confuse readers unfamiliar with the term.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Overgeneralization and Lack of Lexical Precision
top_error_patterns.description: Statements use imprecise or absolute language that misrepresents standard definitions or concepts, leading to potential misunderstandings for learners.

examples.wrong: Variables in algebra can be letters or symbols, and sometimes numbers.
examples.correct: Variables in algebra are typically represented by letters or symbols, not numbers.
examples.context: Misleading implication that variables can be numbers, confusing variables with constants.

examples.wrong: Variables in algebra can be represented by letters, numbers, or symbols, depending on the context and the preference of the mathematician.
examples.correct: Variables in algebra are usually represented by letters or symbols, not numbers. Numbers typically represent constants.
examples.context: Incorrectly suggests that numbers can represent variables, which is not standard in algebra.

examples.wrong: The climate zone characterized by moderate temperatures and precipitation, supporting diverse ecosystems, cannot be found at the equator.
examples.correct: A climate zone characterized by moderate temperatures and precipitation, supporting diverse ecosystems, is typically not found at the equator.
examples.context: Absolute phrasing ('cannot be found') misleads learners; should indicate typicality, not impossibility.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of participial phrases or modifiers that ambiguously attach to the wrong part of the sentence, reducing clarity.

examples.wrong: These patterns are influenced by geographical location and various environmental factors, leading to the classification of regions into different climate types.
examples.correct: These patterns are influenced by geographical location and various environmental factors, which lead to the classification of regions into different climate types.
examples.context: Dangling modifier makes the causal relationship unclear.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inconsistent Use of Regionally Recognized Medical Terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Medical terms like 'Heimlich maneuver' may not be universally recognized; pairing with more generic or globally accepted terms improves clarity and accessibility.

examples.correct: abdominal thrusts (Heimlich maneuver)
examples.context: Quiz questions referencing emergency procedures

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent mistakes in gender and number agreement between adjectives, pronouns, and nouns, leading to confusion and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: Les Égyptiens ont appris à exploiter les crues annuelles du Nil, qui apportaient des alluvions riche en nutriments à leurs champs.
examples.correct: Les Égyptiens ont appris à exploiter les crues annuelles du Nil, qui apportaient des alluvions riches en nutriments à leurs champs.
examples.context: Adjective 'riche' should agree in number with 'alluvions' (plural).

examples.correct: maximiser leurs chances de survie
examples.context: Possessive pronoun 'leur' should agree in number with 'chances' (plural).

examples.wrong: En programmation, on utilise les conditionnels pour afficher le même message quel que soit la valeur de la variable.
examples.correct: En programmation, on utilise les conditionnels pour afficher le même message quelle que soit la valeur de la variable.
examples.context: Phrase 'quel que soit' should agree in gender with 'valeur' (feminine).

top_error_patterns.description: Recurrent spelling and typographical errors that undermine professionalism and can hinder comprehension.

examples.correct: Marchi.e.
examples.context: Extra period and letter 'e' create a non-standard, confusing term.

examples.wrong: Imaginez si vous devaiez écrire une salutation pour un groupe de cinq amis, une boucle pourrait faire ce travail rapidement pour vous.
examples.correct: Imaginez si vous deviez écrire une salutation pour un groupe de cinq amis, une boucle pourrait faire ce travail rapidement pour vous.
examples.context: Misspelling of 'deviez' (imparfait, 2nd person plural) as 'devaiez'.

top_error_patterns.description: Misuse of introductory phrases that result in syntactic confusion and misinterpretation of the intended meaning.

examples.wrong: En attendant, montrer de l'empathie et une volonté de comprendre la perspective de l'autre peut créer un climat plus propice à une discussion constructive.
examples.correct: En montrant de l'empathie et une volonté de comprendre la perspective de l'autre, on peut créer un climat plus propice à une discussion constructive.
examples.context: Use of 'En attendant' is syntactically incorrect and misleading in this context.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Misinformation due to Inaccurate Scientific Localization
top_error_patterns.description: Scientific concepts are inaccurately localized, leading to culturally or contextually inappropriate information that can mislead learners about fundamental topics.

examples.wrong: La digestion des aliments est un processus qui se produit dans l'intestin grêle chez les humains et les animaux, tandis que dans les plantes, elle se produit dans des structures comme les glandes.
examples.correct: Chez les plantes, il s'agit plutôt de la décomposition et de l'absorption des nutriments, qui ne se fait pas dans des glandes mais dans des structures comme les vacuoles ou par des enzymes spécifiques.
examples.context: Describes plant digestion using incorrect anatomical terms, misrepresenting biological processes.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect or inconsistent use of French typographic conventions
top_error_patterns.description: Recurring issues with French-specific typographic rules, such as use of straight apostrophes instead of typographic ones, missing non-breaking spaces before punctuation, and use of English quotation marks instead of guillemets.

examples.correct: Introduction à l’algèbre
examples.context: Title capitalization and typographic apostrophe

examples.correct: Exemples réels :
examples.context: Missing non-breaking space before colon

examples.wrong: Marche sur Washington (1963) : ... "I Have a Dream".
examples.correct: Marche sur Washington (1963) : ... « I Have a Dream ».
examples.context: Use of English quotation marks instead of guillemets

top_error_patterns.description: Recurring use of inaccurate or non-standard French terms for key concepts, leading to confusion and reduced clarity for learners. This includes literal translations or English terms left untranslated, which do not align with established French usage in educational or legal contexts.

examples.correct: le sexe
examples.context: Misuse of a non-standard phrase instead of the accepted legal term for 'sex' in anti-discrimination contexts.

examples.correct: Comité de coordination des étudiants non-violents (SNCC)
examples.context: Leaving the organization name in English without a French equivalent, reducing accessibility for French learners.

examples.correct: Calculatrice basique
examples.context: Incorrect use of 'calculateur' (meaning processor) instead of 'calculatrice' (calculator), causing potential misunderstanding.

top_error_patterns.description: Phrases are structured in a way that does not follow natural French syntax, leading to awkward or unclear sentences.

examples.wrong: Bosses stockant de la graisse pour survivre sans nourriture longtemps.
examples.correct: Bosses stockant de la graisse pour survivre longtemps sans nourriture.
examples.context: Adverb placement disrupts clarity and natural flow.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of imprecise or non-standard verbs or terms in scientific contexts, reducing clarity and accuracy.

examples.wrong: Les ribosomes travaillent en collant les acides aminés pour former des protéines...
examples.correct: Les ribosomes assemblent les acides aminés pour former des protéines...
examples.context: Inaccurate verb choice for scientific process.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect use of terms and decimal separators that do not conform to French conventions, affecting professionalism and clarity.

examples.correct: taille = 1,65
examples.context: Wrong term for height and incorrect decimal separator.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-idiomatic or Colloquial Phrasing in Educational Contexts
top_error_patterns.description: Use of phrasing that is grammatically correct but less natural, too informal, or metaphorical for French educational materials. Corrections improve idiomaticity and professional tone.

examples.correct: Voici quelques exemples d'adaptations physiques :
examples.context: Introducing examples in a lesson

examples.wrong: Organites en forme de haricot avec une double membrane.
examples.correct: Organites de forme ovale avec une double membrane.
examples.context: Describing mitochondria in biology

examples.wrong: Substance gélatineuse qui remplit la cellule.
examples.correct: Substance semi-liquide qui remplit la cellule.
examples.context: Describing cytoplasm

examples.wrong: Préparez-vous à plonger dans les mystères de notre atmosphère et de nos océans !
examples.correct: Préparez-vous à explorer les phénomènes de notre atmosphère et de nos océans !
examples.context: Lesson introduction

examples.correct: LGBT+
examples.context: Referring to communities in a French context

top_error_patterns.description: Inconsistent or incomplete use of terminology, missing prepositions for parallel structure, or lack of explanation for acronyms, which can reduce clarity and accessibility.

examples.wrong: Les vacuoles dans les cellules animales peuvent varier considérablement en taille et fonction selon le type de tissu.
examples.correct: Les vacuoles dans les cellules animales peuvent varier considérablement en taille et en fonction selon le type de tissu.
examples.context: Listing characteristics in biology

examples.correct: NAACP (Association nationale pour l'avancement des personnes de couleur)
examples.context: Mentioning organizations unfamiliar to French learners

examples.correct: le courant antarctique circumpolaire
examples.context: Scientific terminology in geography

top_error_patterns.description: Non-standard formatting for currency, units, or punctuation that does not follow French typographic rules, such as missing non-breaking spaces or incorrect symbol placement.

examples.context: Currency in math or economics questions

examples.correct: print("Bonjour " + nom + " !")
examples.context: Output formatting in code examples

examples.correct: 60 km/h
examples.context: Units of speed (ensure non-breaking space)

top_error_patterns.description: Mathematical expressions use juxtaposed variables and numbers (e.g., '2x', '60t') instead of the multiplication sign or a space, which can cause confusion in French educational contexts.

examples.correct: Coût total = 2 × x
examples.context: Multiplication in algebraic expressions

examples.correct: Distance = 60 × t
examples.context: Multiplication in physics formulas

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as the globe (🌍) are used in formal educational content, which is not standard in French academic materials and can undermine professionalism.

examples.wrong: Découvrez une civilisation fascinante, connue pour ses pyramides majestueuses, son écriture unique et son rôle fondamental dans l'histoire humaine. 🌍
examples.correct: Découvrez une civilisation fascinante, connue pour ses pyramides majestueuses, son écriture unique et son rôle fondamental dans l'histoire humaine.
examples.context: Introduction to a historical topic

examples.wrong: À travers des actions militantes, des lois importantes, et des décisions judiciaires marquantes, ce mouvement a transformé la société américaine et inspiré des efforts mondiaux pour la justice sociale et l'égalité. 🌍
examples.correct: À travers des actions militantes, des lois importantes et des décisions judiciaires marquantes, ce mouvement a transformé la société américaine et inspiré des efforts mondiaux pour la justice sociale et l'égalité.
examples.context: Summary of a social movement

top_error_patterns.description: Order of countries or examples does not align with French cultural conventions, potentially affecting relatability or perceived bias.

examples.wrong: la majeure partie des États-Unis et de l'Europe
examples.correct: la majeure partie de l'Europe et des États-Unis
examples.context: Listing regions in a geography or history context

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lexical False Friends and Inaccurate Terminology
top_error_patterns.description: Systematic misuse of words due to false friends or inaccurate terminology, leading to scientific or cultural misunderstandings.

examples.correct: Körperliche Anpassungen
examples.context: Incorrect term for biological adaptations; 'physikalisch' refers to physics, not physical traits.

examples.correct: Osiris
examples.context: Non-standard, confusing term for the Egyptian god.

examples.correct: finden
examples.context: Lexical error in mathematical context; 'erfinden' means 'to invent', not 'to find'.

examples.correct: die DNA
examples.context: Incorrect article for 'DNA'; should be feminine in German.

examples.correct: Butter auf eine Scheibe streichen.
examples.context: Culturally inaccurate use of 'Erdnussbutter' for 'Butterbrot'.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misspellings of the word 'hauptsächlich' (mainly/primarily) with non-existent forms, leading to confusion and loss of meaning.

examples.correct: hauptsächlich
examples.context: Misspelled in quiz item, making the sentence unclear.

examples.correct: hauptsächlich
examples.context: Misspelled in quiz item, impeding comprehension.

examples.correct: hauptsächlich
examples.context: Misspelled in quiz item, affecting clarity.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent errors in gender agreement and case usage, leading to ungrammatical and confusing sentences.

examples.wrong: Ihr dicker Fell ist eine physikalische Anpassung, die ihnen hilft, das extreme Klima zu überstehen.
examples.correct: Ihr dickes Fell ist eine körperliche Anpassung, die ihnen hilft, das extreme Klima zu überstehen.
examples.context: Adjective does not agree with neuter noun 'Fell'.

examples.wrong: DNA-Synthese findet in der Zellkern statt.
examples.correct: DNA-Synthese findet im Zellkern statt.
examples.context: Incorrect case and article for 'Zellkern'.

examples.wrong: Mitochondrien sind die Zelle, die für die Energieproduktion verantwortlich ist.
examples.correct: Mitochondrien sind die Zellbestandteile, die für die Energieproduktion verantwortlich sind.
examples.context: Singular used for plural subject; incorrect noun and verb agreement.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or incorrect names for species or scientific terms, affecting accuracy and learner trust.

examples.correct: Kaktuszaunkönig
examples.context: Incorrect species name; '-königin' is not used in standard German for this bird.

top_error_patterns.description: Source content includes culturally specific items or practices (e.g., American foods) that do not align with the target culture, leading to confusion or reduced relatability for learners.

examples.correct: Butter auf eine Scheibe streichen.
examples.context: Reference to peanut butter as a spread, which is uncommon in German culture; 'Butter' is the culturally appropriate choice.

top_error_patterns.description: Direct translations or literal expressions from English that are understandable but sound unnatural or less idiomatic in German educational contexts. Replacing them with more natural German phrasing improves clarity and professionalism.

examples.correct: Tiere sind wahre Anpassungskünstler
examples.context: Describing animal adaptability in a more idiomatic way

examples.correct: aufgrund der Nähe zum Pazifik
examples.context: Explaining climate influences in a more formal, natural register

examples.wrong: Mit Python sind die Möglichkeiten endlos!
examples.correct: Mit Python sind die Möglichkeiten nahezu unbegrenzt!
examples.context: Avoiding literal translation of 'endless possibilities'

examples.correct: vielseitige, allgemein verwendete Programmiersprache
examples.context: Describing programming languages in a more idiomatic way

examples.correct: f-string format in code examples
examples.context: Using idiomatic Python code style in German programming education

top_error_patterns.description: Use of direct translations or less common terms instead of standard German terminology in educational, technical, or cultural contexts. Adjusting to the preferred local terms improves clarity and aligns with learner expectations.

examples.correct: Leseprüfungen
examples.context: Referring to literacy tests in a historical context

examples.correct: Gemäßigte Zone
examples.context: Geographical terminology in German education

examples.correct: LSBTIQ+-Personen
examples.context: Using the culturally appropriate abbreviation for the German audience

examples.correct: Booleschen Wert
examples.context: Capitalization of technical terms derived from proper nouns

top_error_patterns.description: Phrases are grammatically correct but sound unnatural or incomplete in German, often due to missing particles or incorrect idiomatic usage.

examples.wrong: Wenn es regnet, nimm einen Regenschirm.
examples.correct: Wenn es regnet, nimm einen Regenschirm mit.
examples.context: Missing 'mit' after 'nehmen' in the context of taking something along.

examples.wrong: Variablen können mehr als einen Wert haben.
examples.correct: Variablen können verschiedene Werte annehmen.
examples.context: Misleading phrasing about variable assignment in programming.

examples.wrong: Eine Zelle benötigt einen Zellkern, um ihre Funktionen zu steuern und als Zellkern bekannt.
examples.correct: Eine Zelle benötigt einen Zellkern, um ihre Funktionen zu steuern.
examples.context: Redundant and unclear phrase appended to a sentence about cell biology.

top_error_patterns.description: Compound nouns are incorrectly split into separate words or not properly hyphenated, violating German orthographic and grammatical conventions.

examples.correct: Variablenzuweisung
examples.context: Improper separation of compound noun in programming terminology.

examples.correct: Montgomery-Bus-Boykott
examples.context: Event name not hyphenated as required in German.

top_error_patterns.description: English technical terms are left untranslated in German educational content, reducing clarity and accessibility for learners unfamiliar with English. Localized terminology should be used unless referencing code syntax directly.

examples.correct: Boolean: Wahrheitswerte (wahr oder falsch)
examples.context: Explanations of Boolean values use English keywords instead of German equivalents.

examples.correct: 'Listen' oder 'Wörterbücher'
examples.context: Data structure names are not localized, leading to inconsistency with standard German programming terminology.

top_error_patterns.description: Nouns are not capitalized as required by German orthographic rules, reducing linguistic accuracy and professionalism.

examples.correct: Zuhörfähigkeiten
examples.context: Noun in a sentence about interpersonal skills is not capitalized.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of informal pronouns ('du', 'dir') in contexts where formal address ('Sie', 'Ihnen') is expected, affecting the professional tone of educational materials.

examples.correct: wird Ihnen helfen
examples.context: Informal pronoun used in a general educational context.

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect or unnatural word choices in technical or programming contexts, leading to reduced clarity and authenticity for German learners.

examples.correct: if (regnet) { nimmRegenschirmMit(); }
examples.context: Variable and function names do not reflect natural German usage.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate use of emojis in formal content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🌍, 👩‍💻, and 🌟 are used in introductions or explanations, which is considered informal and not standard in German academic or professional educational materials. Removing them ensures a more neutral and professional tone.

examples.context: Globe emoji at the start of a geography-related sentence

examples.wrong: 👩‍💻 Heute tauchen wir ein in die Welt der Algorithmen...
examples.correct: Heute tauchen wir ein in die Welt der Algorithmen...
examples.context: Emoji at the start of a programming introduction
Star emoji in an educational introduction

top_error_patterns.description: Literal translations or imprecise expressions that do not match standard German idioms or technical phrasing, leading to slightly unnatural or unclear sentences.

examples.wrong: Mit dem Verständnis dieser Grundlagen habt ihr den ersten Schritt zum Programmieren gemacht!
examples.correct: Mit dem Verständnis dieser Grundlagen habt ihr den ersten Schritt zum Programmieren getan!
examples.context: Literal translation of 'made the first step' instead of the idiomatic 'getan' in German.

examples.wrong: Die Anden in Südamerika haben in höheren Lagen kühlere Klimabedingungen, obwohl sie sich in der tropischen Zone befinden.
examples.correct: Die Anden in Südamerika haben in höheren Lagen kühlere Klimabedingungen, obwohl sie sich in der tropischen Klimazone befinden.
examples.context: Use of 'tropische Zone' instead of the precise technical term 'tropische Klimazone'.

top_error_patterns.description: Omission of necessary particles or words in temporal phrases, resulting in slightly awkward or incomplete expressions.

examples.wrong: Eis und Schnee bedecken die Region das ganze Jahr.
examples.correct: Eis und Schnee bedecken die Region das ganze Jahr über.
examples.context: Missing 'über' in the temporal phrase 'das ganze Jahr über'.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lack of German Explanations for English Terms
top_error_patterns.description: Use of English acronyms or terms without providing a German translation or explanation, which may hinder comprehension for learners unfamiliar with the term.

examples.correct: Studentischer Ausschuss für gewaltfreie Koordination (SNCC) oder mit kurzer Erklärung
examples.context: English term used without German equivalent or explanation.

top_error_patterns.description: Statements contain factual errors about climate zones, such as misidentifying the location or characteristics of tropical and polar climates. These errors mislead learners and undermine comprehension.

examples.wrong: 熱帯気候は、極地に位置する地域に見られる主要な気候帯です。
examples.correct: 熱帯気候は、赤道付近に位置する地域に見られる主要な気候帯です。
examples.context: Misidentification of tropical climate location

examples.wrong: 熱帯気候帯では夏と冬の気温差は大きい。
examples.correct: 熱帯気候帯では夏と冬の気温差は小さい。
examples.context: Incorrect description of temperature variation in tropical climates

top_error_patterns.description: Use of nonstandard or incorrect terms for climate zones, leading to confusion and lack of clarity. Proper scientific terminology is essential for educational accuracy.

examples.wrong: 冷却帯の温度は非常に高いため、生物多様性が豊かです。
examples.correct: 極地帯の温度は非常に低いため、生物多様性は限られています。
examples.context: Use of '冷却帯' instead of standard '極地帯' for polar regions

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect Lexical Choice for Animal Features
top_error_patterns.description: Misuse of terms like '皮' (skin) instead of the more contextually appropriate '毛' (fur/hair) when describing animal features, leading to confusion or unnatural phrasing.

examples.wrong: 陸上動物が冬になると皮が退色することはありません。
examples.correct: 陸上動物が冬になると毛が退色することはありません。
examples.context: Describing seasonal changes in animal appearance; 'fur' is correct, not 'skin'.

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences end with a half-width period ('.'), double periods ('..'), or a combination of Japanese full stop (。) and Western period (.), instead of a single full-width Japanese period (。). This disrupts orthographic correctness and the naturalness of Japanese writing.

examples.wrong: ナイル川はエジプトの生涯にわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした.
examples.correct: ナイル川はエジプトの生涯にわたる経済発展の重要な要因でした。
examples.context: Half-width period used at sentence end

examples.wrong: これにより、エジプト人は農業により集中し、経済の発展を促進しました..
examples.correct: これにより、エジプト人は農業により集中し、経済の発展を促進しました。
examples.context: Double half-width periods at sentence end

examples.wrong: 動物は環境変化に適応せず、時間が経つと生存できることがあります。.
examples.correct: 動物は環境変化に適応せず、時間が経つと生存できることがあります。
examples.context: Full-width period followed by half-width period

top_error_patterns.description: Comparative sentences lack necessary qualifiers, leading to potential misunderstanding. For example, not specifying 'year-round' in climate comparisons can mislead readers about temperature differences.

examples.wrong: 熱帯気候帯は大陸性気候帯よりも温度が高いです。
examples.correct: 熱帯気候帯は大陸性気候帯よりも年間を通じて温度が高いです。
examples.context: Missing qualifier in comparative statement

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis are used in educational or formal Japanese content, which can undermine the professional tone expected in such contexts.

examples.wrong: このレッスンでは、気候帯がどのように生態系や人々の活動に影響を与えるかを学びます🌍。
examples.correct: このレッスンでは、気候帯がどのように生態系や人々の活動に影響を与えるかを学びます。
examples.context: Lesson introduction in an educational quiz

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect lexical choices and invented words
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent use of non-existent, mistranslated, or contextually inappropriate words, often resulting in confusion or factual inaccuracy.

examples.correct: peroksysomy, mitochondria czy lizosomy
examples.context: Cell biology terminology

examples.wrong: Ruch Praw Obywatelskich znaczył znaczną poprawę wewnętrznych relacji między różnymi etnicznościami w Stanach Ziemiańskich.
examples.correct: Ruch Praw Obywatelskich oznaczał znaczną poprawę relacji między różnymi grupami etnicznymi w Stanach Zjednoczonych.
examples.context: Historical and geographical terms

examples.wrong: mogą przechowywać liczby całkowite, liczby zmienniste, wartości logiczne czy nawet listy.
examples.correct: mogą przechowywać liczby całkowite, liczby zmiennoprzecinkowe, wartości logiczne czy nawet listy.
examples.context: Programming and mathematics vocabulary

top_error_patterns.description: Systematic mistakes in gender, number, or case agreement between nouns, adjectives, and verbs, leading to unnatural or incorrect sentences.

examples.wrong: W starożytnym Egipsku dobrze znane były żarowce...
examples.correct: W starożytnym Egipcie dobrze znane były żarowce...
examples.context: Locative case error

examples.wrong: Każdy zmienna w programie ma określony typ danych.
examples.correct: Każda zmienna w programie ma określony typ danych.
examples.context: Gender agreement

examples.wrong: Mitochondria jest głównym źródłem energii dla komórki.
examples.correct: Mitochondria są głównym źródłem energii dla komórki.
examples.context: Subject-verb agreement

top_error_patterns.description: Recurrent misspellings and non-standard word forms that disrupt reading flow and comprehension.

examples.correct: zazwyczaj
examples.context: Adverb misspelling in multiple items

examples.correct: nie wykonuje żadnych operacji
examples.context: Verb conjugation and spelling

examples.correct: ponieważ
examples.context: Conjunction misspelling

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences that are grammatically incorrect and/or factually misleading, often due to mistranslation or misunderstanding of the source content.

examples.wrong: Decyzja w Brown v. Board of Education założyła, że segregacja w szkołach publicznych jest zgodna z Konstytucją...
examples.correct: Decyzja w Brown v. Board of Education stwierdziła, że segregacja w szkołach publicznych jest niezgodna z Konstytucją...
examples.context: Historical inaccuracy and grammatical error

examples.wrong: Empatia polega tylko na poczynianiu zobowiązań w stosunku do innych.
examples.correct: Empatia nie polega tylko na poczynianiu zobowiązań w stosunku do innych.
examples.context: Misrepresentation of psychological concepts

top_error_patterns.description: Use of culturally or historically inaccurate references that do not align with the target audience's knowledge or context, leading to confusion or misinformation.

examples.wrong: Egipcjanie używali rzemion do tworzenia złotych kul, które były zarówno dekoracyjne, jak i użyteczne.
examples.correct: Egipcjanie używali narzędzi do tworzenia złotych przedmiotów, które były zarówno dekoracyjne, jak i użyteczne.
examples.context: Misrepresentation of ancient Egyptian artifacts; 'złote kule' is not culturally or historically accurate.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of awkward, confusing, or irrelevant phrasing that disrupts comprehension and fails to meet the expectations of educational content in Polish.

examples.wrong: Jaśne morze, jak przypomina miasto Jastrzębie-Zdroje, znane z żywiołów morskich, odgrywa znaczną rolę w regulacji klimatu. Woda działa jak termost, regulując wzór pogodowy. Te morskie ruchy wpływają na temperaturę, co potwierdza naszą tendencję do prawdy.
examples.correct: Oceany odgrywają znaczącą rolę w regulacji temperatury na Ziemi. Woda magazynuje i oddaje ciepło, wpływając na wzorce pogodowe i temperaturę w różnych regionach.
examples.context: Inclusion of irrelevant city references and unnatural metaphors; misspelling of 'termostat'; overall lack of clarity and educational tone.

top_error_patterns.description: Frequent errors in case agreement or preposition selection, leading to unnatural or incorrect phrasing and reduced clarity.

examples.wrong: co skutkowałoby błędne działanie lub błąd kompilacji.
examples.correct: co skutkowałoby błędnym działaniem lub błędem kompilacji.
examples.context: Instrumental case required after 'skutkowałoby'.

examples.wrong: Dowód, że 'Ten krem przeciwsłoneczny jest bezpieczny, ponieważ jest na rynku przez wiele lat.
examples.correct: Dowód, że 'Ten krem przeciwsłoneczny jest bezpieczny, ponieważ jest na rynku od wielu lat.'
examples.context: Incorrect preposition for expressing duration.

examples.wrong: Ostateczne rodzaj przechowywanej informacji zależy od tego, jak zmienne są definiowane w języku programowania.
examples.correct: Ostateczny rodzaj przechowywanej informacji zależy od tego, jak zmienne są definiowane w języku programowania.
examples.context: Adjective-noun gender and case agreement.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of words or phrases that are unnatural, incorrect, or calques from English, resulting in awkward or unclear sentences.

examples.wrong: procesy wewnętrzne, które nie są zobrazowane na zewnątrz organizmu
examples.correct: procesy wewnętrzne, które nie są widoczne na zewnątrz organizmu
examples.context: Literal translation; 'zobrazowane' is not idiomatic here.

examples.wrong: Ta faktualność opiera się na podstawowej wiedzy w kodowaniu...
examples.correct: Ta prawidłowość opiera się na podstawowej wiedzy w kodowaniu...
examples.context: Calque from English; 'faktualność' is not a standard Polish term.

examples.wrong: każda zmienna jest zarejestrowana z konkretnym typem danych
examples.correct: każda zmienna jest przypisana do konkretnego typu danych
examples.context: Incorrect verb choice; 'zarejestrowana' is not used in this context.

top_error_patterns.description: Mistakes in spelling, euphony, or word formation, leading to nonstandard or awkward expressions.

examples.correct: ze znakiem równości
examples.context: Euphonic rule requires 'ze' before 'z'.

examples.correct: w rozwiązywaniu konfliktów
examples.context: Incorrect form; gerund required for ongoing process.

examples.wrong: zwiększyć szacun i zwiększyć szczegółowe rozwiązanie problemu
examples.correct: zwiększyć szacunek i ułatwić szczegółowe rozwiązanie problemu
examples.context: Colloquial truncation and awkward phrasing.

top_error_patterns.description: Technical terms are either left untranslated or translated using non-standard equivalents, leading to reduced clarity and professionalism in educational content.

examples.correct: wywołania systemowe
examples.context: English term used instead of standard Polish technical term

examples.correct: liczby zmiennoprzecinkowe
examples.context: Non-standard Polish term used for 'float' instead of the accepted technical term

top_error_patterns.description: Sentences lacking a main verb or being incomplete, which affects clarity and professionalism.

examples.wrong: Białka przeciwzamrożeniowe u ryb arktycznych zapobiegające tworzeniu się kryształów lodu we krwi.
examples.correct: Białka przeciwzamrożeniowe u ryb arktycznych zapobiegają tworzeniu się kryształów lodu we krwi.
examples.context: Fragment missing main verb.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less precise or non-standard scientific terms instead of established terminology, which can reduce clarity and accuracy in educational content.

examples.wrong: magazynowanie wody w ciele wielbłąda to fizjologiczna adaptacja
examples.correct: magazynowanie wody w ciele wielbłąda to fizjologiczne przystosowanie
examples.context: Biological adaptation terminology in science quizzes

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Verb Choice for Technical Context
top_error_patterns.description: Selection of verbs that do not accurately convey the intended technical meaning, leading to potential misunderstanding of key concepts.

examples.wrong: Język naturalny nie może obsługiwać złożonych instrukcji programowych potrzebnych do działania komputera.
examples.correct: Język naturalny nie pozwala na precyzyjne określenie złożonych instrukcji programowych potrzebnych do działania komputera.
examples.context: Describing limitations of natural language in computer science context

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Incorrect lexical choice leading to factual errors
top_error_patterns.description: Frequent misuse of terms that result in factual inaccuracies or misrepresentation of concepts, which can mislead learners and undermine educational value.

examples.wrong: O retículo endoplasmático liso, sem ribossomos, é especializado na elaboração de proteínas que a célula vai liberar para fora.
examples.correct: O retículo endoplasmático liso, sem ribossomos, é especializado na elaboração de lipídios e na desintoxicação celular, não na síntese de proteínas para secreção.
examples.context: Confusion between functions of smooth and rough endoplasmic reticulum.

examples.wrong: Dr. King foi uma figura proeminente nos anos 60, defendendo a igualdade racial por meio de boatos pacíficos e discursos inspiradores.
examples.correct: Dr. King foi uma figura proeminente nos anos 60, defendendo a igualdade racial por meio de protestos pacíficos e discursos inspiradores.
examples.context: Misuse of 'boatos' (rumors) instead of 'protestos' (protests) in historical context.

examples.wrong: O formador de zonas climáticas é influenciado por vários fatores como o aquecimento desigual da Terra, a rotação e a forma da Terra, e as correntes oceânicas.
examples.correct: A formação das zonas climáticas é influenciada por vários fatores, como o aquecimento desigual da Terra, a rotação e a forma da Terra, e as correntes oceânicas.
examples.context: Incorrect term 'formador' instead of 'formação' for climate zone formation.

examples.wrong: A zona tropical, que é contrastante com regiões como o Deserto do Saara, onde as temperaturas são extremamente baixas.
examples.correct: A zona tropical, que contrasta com regiões como o Deserto do Saara, onde as temperaturas são extremamente altas.
examples.context: Incorrect description of Sahara Desert temperatures and unnatural lexical choice.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Gender agreement errors with nouns and articles
top_error_patterns.description: Mistakes in gender agreement between articles and nouns, which affect grammatical correctness and can hinder comprehension.

examples.correct: pelas mitocôndrias
examples.context: Incorrect masculine article used with feminine plural noun.

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less idiomatic or imprecise phrases that, while grammatically correct, reduce clarity and naturalness in educational Portuguese. Corrections favor more precise or commonly accepted expressions.

examples.correct: cenas do cotidiano
examples.context: Describing everyday scenes in historical or cultural contexts.

examples.correct: por vez
examples.context: Explaining variable data type capacity in programming.

examples.correct: só é executada se
examples.context: Describing conditional execution in logic statements.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Inappropriate Use of Emojis in Formal Educational Content
top_error_patterns.description: Emojis such as 🎓 and 🌟 are used in educational content where a neutral and professional tone is expected. Their presence can undermine the seriousness and clarity of the material, especially for older students or official contexts.

examples.correct: Vamos começar!
examples.context: Quiz introduction; emoji adds informality

examples.wrong: Prepare-se para desenvolver ferramentas que o ajudarão a analisar questões complexas e participar de discussões significativas! 🌟
examples.correct: Prepare-se para desenvolver ferramentas que o ajudarão a analisar questões complexas e participar de discussões significativas!
examples.context: Motivational sentence; emoji is unnecessary
Standalone emoji at the end of an introduction

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission of Definite Articles in Noun Phrases
top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles are frequently omitted before nouns, leading to unnatural or ambiguous noun phrases in Brazilian Portuguese.

examples.correct: promovendo o comércio e o intercâmbio cultural
examples.context: Educational content describing historical or cultural processes

examples.correct: valores desconhecidos ou variáveis desconhecidas
examples.context: Definitions or explanations in math/science contexts

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Lexical Inaccuracy and Calques from English
top_error_patterns.description: Use of non-standard or awkward lexical choices, often due to direct translation from English, resulting in unnatural phrasing for Brazilian Portuguese.

examples.correct: as variáveis possuem tipos
examples.context: Technical explanations in programming or computer science

examples.correct: se misturar ao ambiente
examples.context: Biological or environmental descriptions

top_error_patterns.description: Use of European Portuguese spelling instead of Brazilian Portuguese, affecting regional appropriateness and standardization.

examples.correct: seletiva
examples.context: Scientific or technical terminology

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect gender agreement between subject and verb/adjective, leading to grammatical inaccuracies.

examples.wrong: Strings podem ser armazenados como números.
examples.correct: Strings podem ser armazenadas como números.
examples.context: Programming or technical explanations

top_error_patterns.description: Prepositions required by certain verbs are omitted, resulting in incorrect verb-preposition usage and reduced clarity.

examples.correct: opções que atendam a todos
examples.context: Instructions or collaborative activity prompts

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Non-standard or inaccurate terminology for legal references
top_error_patterns.description: Use of terms that do not match the standard or widely accepted translations for official legislation, leading to potential confusion or lack of recognition among local audiences.

examples.correct: Lei de Igualdade de Oportunidades Educacionais de 1974
examples.context: Reference to U.S. educational equality law in quiz content

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Overly restrictive or misleading style in technical instructions
top_error_patterns.description: Instructions or explanations that impose unnecessary restrictions or misrepresent conventions, potentially confusing learners and reducing clarity.

examples.wrong: Os nomes devem começar com uma letra minúscula ou um underscore seguido de uma letra minúscula.
examples.correct: Os nomes devem começar com uma letra ou um underscore.
examples.context: Explanation of Python variable naming rules in educational content

top_error_patterns.description: Use of less natural or literal phrasing that does not align with idiomatic Brazilian Portuguese, especially in educational or technical contexts.

examples.wrong: Se João tem `x` maçãs e compra mais 5, o total de maçãs que ele possui pode ser representado como `x + 5`.
examples.correct: Se João tem `x` maçãs e compra mais 5, o total de maçãs que ele possui pode ser representado por `x + 5`.
examples.context: Mathematical explanation; preposition choice

examples.wrong: Quando o jogador ganha pontos, o valor dentro da caixa muda.
examples.correct: Quando o jogador ganha pontos, o valor dentro da caixa é atualizado.
examples.context: Programming analogy; more idiomatic verb

top_error_patterns.description: Incorrect placement of adjectives or modifiers, leading to awkward or less clear phrasing. Corrections restore standard Portuguese word order for improved readability.

examples.correct: consumo externo de água
examples.context: Explaining water consumption in biological contexts.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Missing or incorrect punctuation in parenthetical expressions
top_error_patterns.description: Omission of commas around parenthetical phrases, which can hinder readability and do not conform to standard Portuguese punctuation rules.

examples.context: Explaining mathematical terminology in equations.

top_error_patterns.pattern_name: Omission or Inconsistency of Definite Articles
top_error_patterns.description: Definite articles are omitted before nouns in lists, which is acceptable in informal speech but less natural and stylistically inconsistent in written educational Portuguese. Including articles improves formality and clarity.

examples.wrong: Prepare-se para descobrir a geografia, cultura, governo e as contribuições do Egito Antigo para o mundo moderno!
examples.correct: Prepare-se para descobrir a geografia, a cultura, o governo e as contribuições do Egito Antigo para o mundo moderno!
examples.context: Introductory sentence listing multiple topics

top_error_patterns.description: The term 'coletores de impostos' is used instead of the more standard 'cobradores de impostos', which is preferred in Brazilian Portuguese for clarity and professional tone.

examples.wrong: O governo egípcio dependia de uma rede de oficiais, escribas e coletores de impostos para gerenciar recursos e aplicar leis.
examples.correct: O governo egípcio dependia de uma rede de oficiais, escribas e cobradores de impostos para gerenciar recursos e aplicar leis.
examples.context: Description of government roles
